verdict.summary: MOTILALOFS scores 49/100 and fails the Trend Template (price 941.95 is below the 50 DMA at 1011.27, criterion c5), so under Minervini rules it is a Reject / AVOID regardless of its 196% latest-quarter EPS print. Wait for a proper base on the right side of a rising 50 DMA before reconsidering.
strengths: Latest quarter EPS YoY growth very strong (A1 full 8/8) and latest annual EPS growth +44%
Price 53.2% above 52-week low and only 13.6% below 52-week high — in the upper part of its range
RS percentile 77 with up/down volume ratio 1.41 and rising 200 DMA
Zero promoter pledge, no dilution (share count flat 2 yrs), MF+FII holding rising over recent quarters
First base since Stage 2 (base_count 1) with 18.7% depth
weaknesses: Fails Trend Template: price below 50 DMA (c5) — status SCORED_NO_TREND
EPS volatility: loss quarters in the trailing 8-quarter series; A2 acceleration 0/5
3-yr EPS CAGR only ~3% (A4 = 0) despite the latest-year surge
Poor cash conversion: 3-yr OCF/PAT -0.76 and negative FCF (-₹6,160 cr) — red flag POOR_CASH_CONVERSION
Leverage: D/E 1.73, interest coverage 3.17x, ROCE 12.7%, ROE 15.5%
Base structure weak: no clean contraction sequence (6.2 → 3.3 → 9.1 → 11.7 → 9.8), final contraction volume only -2.8% vs 50d avg (no dry-up), weekly tightness 12.5%
Industry group RS in 3rd quartile (H1 = 0); stock ranks 6th of 100 in its group
